newsitem.title: USA: Plaintiff withdraws from U.S. Sumitomo lawsuit.
newsitem.headline: Plaintiff withdraws from U.S. Sumitomo lawsuit.

text.p: A plaintiff has withdrawn from the consolidated lawsuit filed in the New York Federal Court on April 10 alleging that Sumitomo Corp, its former head trader Yasuo Hamanaka and others rigged the copper market.
Geoffrey Horn of law firm Lovell & Skirnick, representing the plaintiffs, said Eric Zuccarelli had decided to pull out.
Horn was unable to give a reason.
Zuccarelli declined to comment on his withdrawal.

The consolidated lawsuit was filed under seal and Horn said the firm was working toward making public the identities of the new defendents listed in the consolidated case which bundled several lawsuits filed last year.
Horn could not say when the new defendants would be revealed.
